headline: Vietnam proposes 30% tax cut for small firms and households
summary: The proposal would lower income-tax bills as Vietnam tries to support smaller businesses and household enterprises.
script: Vietnam has proposed cutting income tax by thirty percent for small firms and business households. The plan would reduce the burden on smaller enterprises as the government tries to keep growth moving.
